name: SegmentedControl
description: A row of connected buttons where exactly one option is chosen, for switching a view or a setting with two to five choices. Use SegmentedControlItem for each option.

label.description: What the control chooses, e.g. 'View'. It is the accessible name of the group.

children.description: SegmentedControlItem elements, each with an id.

defaultSelectedKey.description: Initial selected item id when uncontrolled.

onChange.description: Called with the id of the chosen item.

keyboard: Tab enters the group, on the chosen option
Arrow keys move to and choose the next or previous option
requirements: A radio group named by label, with each option a radio
The chosen option is marked by fill and weight and by aria-checked, not only by color
Exactly one option is always chosen
Selected text meets 4.5:1 against its background
screenReader: Announced as a radio group with the label, then each option as "radio button, N of M, checked or not checked"
Moving with arrow keys announces the newly chosen option

use_when: Switching between views of the same data: List, Board, Calendar
A setting with two to five short options, like Monthly or Yearly
avoid_when: More than five options or long labels: use Select or RadioGroup
Choosing several at once: use checkboxes
Navigating to different pages: use Tabs or links
anti_patterns: Options that are not mutually exclusive
Icon-only options without a text label
